an11.9:1.1: 9 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati iñjakāvasathe.
an11.9:1.2: athakho āyasmā sandho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sandhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an11.9:2.4: assakhaḷuṅgo hi sandha doṇiyā bandho yavasassaṃ yavasassanti jhāyati
an11.9:2.6: na hi sandha assakhaḷuṅgassa doṇiyā bandhassa evaṃ hoti
an11.9:2.7: kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati kimassāhaṃ paṭikaromīti
an11.9:2.8: so doṇiyā bandho yavasassaṃ yavasassanti jhāyati
an11.9:2.9: evameva kho sandha idhekacco purisakhaḷuṅgo araññagatopi rukkhamūlagatopi suññāgāragatopi kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an11.9:2.10: so kāmarāgaṃ yeva anantaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati
an11.9:2.14: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an11.9:2.15: so vicikicchaṃyeva anantaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati
an11.9:2.16: so paṭhavimpi nissāya jhāyati āpampi nissāya jhāyati tejampi nissāya jhāyati vāyampi nissāya jhāyati ākāsānañcāyatanampi nissāya jhāyati viññāṇañcāyatanampi nissāya jhāyati ākiñcaññāyatanampi nissāya jhāyati nevasaññānāsaññāyatanampi nissāya jhāyati idhalokampi nissāya jhāyati paralokampi nissāya jhāyati yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi nissāya jhāyati
an11.9:3.2: bhadro hi sandha assājānīyo doṇiyā bandho na yavasassaṃ yavasassanti jhāyati
an11.9:3.4: bhadrassa hi sandha assājānīyassa doṇiyā bandhassa evaṃ hoti
an11.9:3.5: kiṃ nu kho ajja maṃ assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati kimassāhaṃ paṭikaromīti
an11.9:3.6: so doṇiyā bandho na yavasassaṃ yavasassanti jhāyati
an11.9:3.7: bhadro hi sandha assājānīyo yathā iṇaṃ yathābandhaṃ yathā jāni yathā kalī evaṃ patodassa ajjhoharaṇaṃ samanupassati
an11.9:3.8: evameva kho sandha bhadro purisājānīyo araññagatopi rukkhamūlagatopi suññāgāragatopi na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an11.9:3.12: na vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na vicikicchāparetena uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an11.9:3.13: so neva paṭhaviṃ nissāya jhāyati na āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati na tejaṃ nissāya jhāyati na vāyaṃ nissāya jhāyati na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na idhalokaṃ nissāya jhāyati na paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi nissāya na jhāyati
an11.9:3.15: evaṃjhāyiñcapana sandha bhadraṃ purisājānīyaṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakāva namassanti
an11.9:5.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sandho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an11.9:5.2: kathaṃ jhāyī pana bhante bhadro purisājānīyo jhāyati so neva paṭhaviṃ nissāya jhāyati na āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati na tejaṃ nissāya jhāyati na vāyaṃ nissāya jhāyati na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na idhalokaṃ nissāya jhāyati na paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi nissāya na jhāyati
an11.9:5.4: kathaṃ jhāyiñcapana bhante bhadraṃ purisājānīyaṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakāva namassanti
an11.9:7.1: idha sandha bhadrassa purisājānīyassa paṭhaviyā paṭhavīsaññā vibhūtā hoti āpasmiṃ āposaññā vibhūtā hoti tejasmiṃ tejosaññā vibhūtā hoti vāyasmiṃ vāyosaññā vibhūtā hoti ākāsānañcāyatane ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti viññāṇañcāyatane viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti ākiñcaññāyatane ākiñcañāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti nevasaññānāsaññāyatane nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti idhaloke idhalokasaññā vibhūtā hoti paraloke paralokasaññā vibhūtā hoti yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tatrāpi saññā vibhūtā hoti
an11.9:7.2: evaṃjhāyī kho sandha bhadro purisājānīyo neva paṭhaviṃ nissāya jhāyati na āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati na tejaṃ nissāya jhāyati na vāyaṃ nissāya jhāyati na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya
an11.9:7.3: jhāyati na ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya jhāyati na idhalokaṃ nissāya jhāyati na paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi nissāya na jhāyati
